subject: devtools:::find_pkg_topic - suggested correction to code when searching for a .Rd file

messages.author: 4a524b7e3012fc77
messages.subject: devtools:::find_pkg_topic - suggested correction to code when searching for a .Rd file
parts:
Hi

I think the line of code in find_pkg_topic the release version of devtools as at 3 August 2014 (devtools_1.5) which currently reads

man_rd <- file.path(pkg$path, "man", paste(topic, ".Rd"))

should really be

man_rd <- file.path(pkg$path, "man", paste(topic, ".Rd",sep=""))

to do what I think it is meant to be doing.

I'm sure there is a better way of suggesting this - but I'm working my way up a steep learning curve (steep for me anyway) trying to create and document my very first (baby) R package and this is the best I could figure out how to do.

Hope this helps

Geoff

PS devtools and roxygen2 are great. Really looking forward to the Advanced R book when it comes out!
